# Interoperability fixtures

These files were generated by the **upstream C++ MMKV v2.4.3** through
`Core/cbridge/MMKVBridge.h`, using the same `MMKV/Core` sources that ship in
this repository.

Generation summary (one-shot, before the C++ bridge was removed from the
workspace):

| Fixture | Contents |
|---|---|
| `plain_basic` | bool/i32/u32/i64/u64/f32/f64/string/empty string/bytes/empty bytes/10 KB string, plus a removed key |
| `plain_bulk` | 200 keys × 300-byte strings (forces growth and full write-back) |
| `plain_trim` | 500 × 300-byte keys, 480 removed, then `trim()` |
| `plain_clear` | one key then `clearAll()` |
| `specialCharacter/…` | id `fixture/a:b` (MD5 file name) |
| `crypt128` | AES-128 key `0123456789abcdef`; small and 5 KB values, bytes, a removed key |
| `crypt256` | AES-256 key `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef`; 1 KB value |
| `crypt_single` | one key updated 25 times (random-IV reuse regression) |
| `crypt_bulk` | 300 × 300-byte encrypted values |
| `expire` | key expiration enabled; `keep`/`num` valid for an hour, `gone` expired |

`crates/mmkv/tests/fixtures.rs` opens these files read-only and verifies every
value. This keeps byte-level compatibility coverage without requiring a C++
toolchain at test time.
